messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help get your son's Vyvanse transferred. First, let me verify his identity—what's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: It's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. I'm his dad, Kevin Brooks, DOB 8/30/82. Can we get this moving? He runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'll get this moving right away. Let me verify Eli's information and then look up his prescriptions and the Rehoboth store. Perfect, Kevin. Eli's verified and I found the Rehoboth store. I see his Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication at our main store, so I need to confirm availability with the Rehoboth pharmacy first before we move it—that takes a few minutes. Let me flag our pharmacist to check with them and confirm it can be filled there. Great. I've flagged our pharmacist to confirm the Rehoboth store can fill it and to complete the transfer. They'll handle the pharmacist-to-pharmacist call right after this, and you should be all set to pick it up there. The Rehoboth store is at 200 Rehoboth Ave, right by the boardwalk. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions, flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Okay, good, that's what I needed to hear. So it'll definitely be ready before Sunday, right? That's the address, right by the boardwalk?
AGENT: Yes, 200 Rehoboth Ave is right by the boardwalk—that's the one. As for Sunday, the pharmacist will confirm with that store right now, and they'll handle the transfer. I've flagged it as same-day priority, so it should move quickly, but I want to be straight with you: I can't promise it'll be ready before Sunday until our pharmacist confirms the store has it in stock. They'll make that call in the next few minutes, and if there's any issue, the store or our pharmacy will reach out to you. Does that work?
CALLER: Alright, that's fair, I just need to know one way or the other before Sunday hits. You'll call me if there's a problem, right?
AGENT: The pharmacist will reach out if there's any issue with getting it ready. Since you're on vacation, make sure the store has your best contact number—do you want to give me a phone number to make sure they have it to call you if needed?
CALLER: Yeah, use this number, it's my cell, I've got it on me all week. Just make sure someone actually calls me, alright?
AGENT (LATEST): I appreciate that, but I don't have a tool to update your contact info in the system—that's something our pharmacy staff handles. When the pharmacist calls the Rehoboth store to confirm the transfer, I'd recommend you call that store directly at your earliest chance and give them your cell number to make sure they have it. That way you know for certain they can reach you if anything comes up. Does that sound good?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks for the dose or strength
move_1: the agent first says the Vyvanse cannot be transferred
move_3: the agent mentions contacting the doctor
move_4: the agent asks which Rehoboth store he means or reads out the two Rehoboth stores
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Home store is Harbor E Broad, Columbus"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "3 capsules left; in Rehoboth until Wed 9/30"
asked_4: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Prescriber is Dr. Lena Okafor"
stop_0: Agent recaps the plan: store, new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor, after-hours line, pharmacist verification.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about dose or strength."}, "move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never said it cannot be transferred."}, "move_3": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of contacting doctor."}, "move_4": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask which Rehoboth store or list two stores."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "No question about home store asked."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "No question about capsules left or dates asked."}, "asked_4": {"met": false, "why": "No question about prescriber asked."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No recap of store, new-Rx, after-hours line given."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
